Veld types: Alexandria Forest; Knysna Forest; Valley Bushveld; Highland and Dohne Sourveld; Dry Cymbopogon- Themeda Veld; False Macchia (cf. Acocks, 1988).
Distribution in the Arabian Peninsula: United Arab Emirates (Strumia 2014). Extralimital distribution: Palestine (Balthasar 1953).
